news.title: Patch Notes — v0.2.1
news.shortDescription: A focused patch addressing connection stability, several bugs, and a new tutorial system.
news.fullBody:
A focused patch addressing connection stability, several bugs, and a new tutorial system.

BUG FIXES
- Fixed a bug that caused the elevator in the construction zone to disappear
- Fixed a bug that caused the camera to become unresponsive in certain situations
- Fixed a bug that occasionally caused the game to run at lower FPS than expected
- Fixed a bug that prevented the launch message from appearing
- Fixed a bug that allowed players to join an already-started game through the server browser
- Fixed a bug that caused some players to not appear in the lobby
- Fixed a bug that prevented the 360! achievement from being unlocked
- Fixed a bug that rarely caused guinea pigs to exit the balloon
- Fixed a bug that prevented the client from earning the Pass All Checkpoints achievement in rare cases
- Fixed a bug that caused certain settings to not save correctly
- Fixed a bug that caused player names to display incorrectly
- Fixed a bug that caused certain Thai characters to render incorrectly
- Fixed various network errors that occurred during game startup
- Fixed a bug that caused disconnections when joining a lobby

IMPROVEMENTS
- Improved connection stability
- Improved ping detection — the system now more accurately identifies network issues and displays the relevant notification
- Improved bug report system
- Improved customization system
- Various level design improvements
- Escaping the boulder in the forest section is now easier

NEW FEATURES
- Added tutorial system

KNOWN ISSUES (we're actively working on these)
- Some AMD GPU users may experience very low FPS due to a driver-level issue affecting AMD Radeon cards. This is outside our control, but updating your drivers resolves it in most cases. We've added an in-game warning that automatically detects AMD cards and notifies affected players — but wanted to flag it here as well.

Have a bug to report, a suggestion, or something you'd like to see in the game? Leave a review, use the in-game feedback button, or reach us on Discord. We read everything and do our best to make it happen.

— DWS Interactive

news.title: Guinea Pig Runaway Together Supporter Pack
news.shortDescription: Support the development and get exclusive in-game goodies with the Guinea Pig Runaway Together Support Pack.
news.fullBody:
Want to help us keep rolling?

The Guinea Pig Runaway Together Support Pack is now available. It includes exclusive cosmetic items and shows your support for an indie team of three working hard to make the best guinea pig co-op experience possible.

Every purchase goes directly back into development. Thank you for being part of this journey.

news.title: Vegawon's Legacy — Wishlist Now on Steam
news.shortDescription: A new adventure from DWS Interactive. Wishlist Vegawon's Legacy on Steam!
news.fullBody:
While we keep rolling with Guinea Pig Runaway Together, we also have something else brewing.

Vegawon's Legacy is a separate project from DWS Interactive. We are not going anywhere Guinea Pig Runaway Together development continues as planned.

If you are curious, head over to the Steam page and add it to your wishlist. It means a lot to us.
